|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Orrimaarko (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). * '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 6, slip 78. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Once per game, may ▲ a rifle and/or an Interrupt with "scout" in game text. Unless Undercover, while alone at an exterior site, opponent's weapon destiny draws here are -2. Immune to attrition < 4.” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same text (the ▲ written out as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”).<ref name="cl-1230_77-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Orrimaarko (V) (Virtual Block 3) (Errata)]]): Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata) removed “Unless Undercover,”<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-16; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announced earlier on the Players Committee rules forum; see the history above). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref>; The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) has the same text<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=12, page 12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=12 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Once per game, may ▲ a rifle and/or an Interrupt with "scout" in game text. While alone at an exterior site, opponent's weapon destiny draws here are -2. Immune to attrition < 4.” The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 13 July 2012, effective immediately<ref name="pcforum-p739757">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 13 July 2012 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=60#p739757 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then.
